name: tracewise
description: Who changed each line, and why: the history Tracewise records for you, your tools and your coding agents.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Tracewise runs a program on your machine, and through it git, which reads a folder's own settings. In a folder you have not trusted the extension does nothing.

tracewise.path.markdownDescription: Path to the `tracewise` program. Empty means the one on your `PATH`.

tracewise.recordSaves.markdownDescription: Tell Tracewise when you save a file, so your own edits are recorded as yours without a background watcher.

tracewise.askWhySave.markdownDescription: After each save that changed something, ask why (Esc skips). The answer is stored as the reason of that change.

tracewise.blame.enabled.markdownDescription: Show who changed each line, and why, at the end of the line.

commands.title: Tracewise: Show the change for this line
Tracewise: Undo the change for this line
Tracewise: Show changes without a reason
